chapters.reason: CoTFormer introduces an explicit architectural modification to allow token-wise variable depth and adaptive computation, fitting the definition of architectural recurrence.
The paper explicitly addresses the bottleneck of model depth and proposes a mechanism to overcome it by dynamically allocating compute, treating depth as a resource.
The architecture mimics Chain-of-Thought at the token level, implying a micro-level correspondence between the iterative application of the model and reasoning steps.
